name: Isshin Intro
_source: s;Shen;A bone face! So you are with those skeletons, huh?
s;Fuuko;Wait, Mr. Shen, they're an ally!{w} This is Isshin, our weaponsmith.|They have been traveling with us...{c:wait;200} well...{c:wait;200} since the start.
s;Shen;Then how come I didn't notice such a big guy this entire time?
s;Fuuko;They said they were shy of strangers.

s;;Isshin is a <blue>Convoyer</>. Player units can access <blue>Item Storage</> when standing next to Isshin.|When convoyer's HP reaches 0, they'll return next chapter, instead of leaving permanently.|However, convoyers cannot move nor fight, so do remember to protect them from harms.;;;Tutorial
